description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts Funnel Bar Chart Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: November 28, 2024 Developer: [InforTime] Main functions: 1. Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive funnel bar charts through Power BI's data model to achieve dynamic data display. 2. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, font, legend position, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. 3. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. 4. Responsive design: The funnel bar chart can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. 5. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: -Demography: display the population distribution of different age groups to form a Population Pyramid. -Sales analysis: Display sales funnels of different products or services to help understand sales structure. -Resource allocation: Display the allocation of resources across different departments or projects. -Organizational structure: Display the hierarchical structure and personnel distribution within the organization. This visualization object aims to provide Power BI users with an innovative and feature rich way of presenting data, helping them better understand and analyze hierarchical data.
